payload.text: **hv, 27 Oct (first-hand in Intent's vc session, relayed by intent-vc, before 12:48:23Z by its date -u): every localfold and every EOD fold clears out what is spent, so a pickup prints only live state.** hv: "And this shouldn't be happening! Localfolds and EODs should clear this out." At each fold: archive each board item and ruling that has been carried out, checked first against its artefact (the commit, the closed issue, the Done WP); a ruling with any part still to do stays live, and a directive stays until hv says it is spent. Clear handled inbox messages, and run `intent wb archive message --handled --node <you>` for sent messages their recipients have handled. A watchout that is still true stays unless a durable home everyone loads carries it (restart.md's Durable Facts, intent/wip.md's Notes, a project memory). Molt's cc, dc and ac do the same at their next fold.
